title: Dobby External Release Evidence v1
description: Shape of an external release-gate evidence record (docs/09_BUILD_RUN_AND_RELEASE.md). status is pinned to "passed" because this format records approvals only; a failed or pending external gate is recorded by the absence of a record, never by a record with another status. A conforming file therefore proves that the human named in attestedBy asserted the external work passed - it is provenance, not verification, and never substitutes for the behavioral proof its gate requires. attestedBy is required because an unattributable approval is not provenance at all: with no identity in the record, a file asserting status passed for a human-only gate names nobody who can be asked what was actually run.

generatedAtUtc.$comment: format is an annotation in JSON Schema 2020-12 unless a validator opts into format assertion, and the previous unanchored "Z$" pattern accepted any string ending in Z, so the shape rule carried no real bound. The enforcing gate is tools/verify-release-candidate/validate-external-evidence.ps1, which parses the value and requires a zero offset; this pattern makes the published shape match that gate instead of understating it.

attestedBy.$comment: Identity of the human who ran the external gate and asserts it passed. status is pinned to "passed", so the record carries an approval and nothing else; without an attributed identity the approval is unattributable and no reviewer can ask what was actually executed. The repository already records approvals this way (artifacts/release-evidence/**/decision-log.md names a designated approver), so this field makes the machine-checked shape match the governance docs/09 section 7 already assumes. The character rules are deliberate: C0/C1 controls, DEL, zero-width characters and Unicode bidi embeds/overrides are excluded because a name that renders as somebody else is worse than a missing one, and the first and last character must be visible non-space, so an untrimmed or all-whitespace value (NBSP and other Unicode spaces included) is not a name. These rules match tools/verify-release-candidate/validate-external-evidence.ps1 exactly; a value this schema accepts and that gate rejects, or the reverse, is a defect in one of the two. Shape only: a syntactically valid name is not proof of authority, and the enforcing gate is that script.
